<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    <meta name="theme-color" content="#0a0a0a" media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)">
    <meta name="theme-color" content="#ffffff" media="(prefers-color-scheme: light)">
    <title>403: Forbidden</title>
    <style>
       
      @font-face {
        font-family: "Geist";
        font-weight: 400 900;
        src: url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");
        unicode-range: U+20-7E, U+2013-2014, U+2018-2019, U+201C-201D, U+2026;
      }
      @font-face {
        font-family: "Geist Mono";
        font-weight: 400;
        src: url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");
        unicode-range: U+20-7E, U+2013-2014, U+2018-2019, U+201C-201D, U+2026;
      }
       

      :root {
        color-scheme: dark;
        --content-width: 283px;
        --content-max-width: 360px;
        --background: #0a0a0a;
        --foreground: #ededed;
        --copy: #ffffff;
        --secondary: #a0a0a0;
        --button-background: #ededed;
        --button-background-hover: #d8d8d8;
        --button-foreground: #0a0a0a;
        --divider: #878787;
        --focus: #0070f3;
      }

      @media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
        :root {
          color-scheme: light;
          --background: #ffffff;
          --foreground: #171717;
          --copy: #171717;
          --secondary: #4d4d4d;
          --button-background: #171717;
          --button-background-hover: #333333;
          --button-foreground: #ffffff;
          --divider: #a8a8a8;
        }
      }

      *,
      *::before,
      *::after {
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }

      html,
      body {
        min-height: 100%;
      }

      body {
        margin: 0;
        background: var(--background);
        color: var(--foreground);
        font-family:
          "Geist",
          -apple-system,
          BlinkMacSystemFont,
          "Segoe UI",
          "Helvetica Neue",
          Arial,
          sans-serif;
        font-synthesis: none;
        -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
      }

      main {
        display: grid;
        min-height: 100vh;
        min-height: 100svh;
        place-items: center;
        padding: 32px;
      }

      .error-page {
        width: fit-content;
        min-width: min(var(--content-width), 100%);
        max-width: min(var(--content-max-width), calc(100vw - 64px));
        transform: translateY(-4px);
      }

      h1,
      p {
        margin: 0;
      }

      h1 {
        color: var(--foreground);
        font-size: 24px;
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: -0.96px;
        line-height: 32px;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        text-wrap: pretty;
      }

      .description {
        width: 100%;
        margin-top: 8px;
        color: var(--copy);
        font-size: 16px;
        font-weight: 400;
        line-height: 24px;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        text-wrap: pretty;
      }

      .primary-action {
        appearance: none;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        min-width: 0;
        height: 32px;
        margin-top: 24px;
        padding: 0 12px;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 6px;
        background: var(--button-background);
        color: var(--button-foreground);
        cursor: pointer;
        font: inherit;
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 500;
        line-height: 20px;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition:
          background-color 150ms ease,
          transform 150ms ease;
        user-select: none;
      }

      .primary-action:hover {
        background: var(--button-background-hover);
      }

      .primary-action:active {
        transform: scale(0.98);
      }

      .primary-action:focus-visible,
      .secondary-action:focus-visible {
        border-radius: 6px;
        outline: 2px solid var(--focus);
        outline-offset: 2px;
      }

      .secondary-actions {
        position: fixed;
        bottom: calc(34px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
        left: 50%;
        z-index: 1;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
        width: var(--content-width);
        max-width: calc(100vw - 64px);
        transform: translateX(-50%);
      }

      .secondary-action {
        appearance: none;
        position: relative;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        padding: 0;
        border: 0;
        background: transparent;
        color: var(--secondary);
        cursor: pointer;
        font-family:
          "Geist Mono",
          "SFMono-Regular",
          Consolas,
          "Liberation Mono",
          Menlo,
          monospace;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 400;
        letter-spacing: 0;
        line-height: 16px;
        text-decoration: none;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        transition: color 150ms ease;
        user-select: none;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      .secondary-action::before {
        position: absolute;
        inset: -4px 0;
        content: "";
      }

      .secondary-action:hover {
        color: var(--foreground);
      }

      .copy-confirmation-icon {
        position: absolute;
        top: 2px;
        left: calc(100% + 8px);
        display: block;
        width: 12px;
        height: 12px;
        color: var(--secondary);
        opacity: 0;
        pointer-events: none;
      }

      .copy-debug-prompt[data-copied] .copy-confirmation-icon {
        opacity: 1;
      }

      .copy-status {
        position: absolute;
        width: 1px;
        height: 1px;
        padding: 0;
        margin: -1px;
        overflow: hidden;
        clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
        white-space: nowrap;
        border: 0;
      }

      .secondary-action-separator {
        display: block;
        flex: none;
        width: 6px;
        height: 10.392px;
        color: var(--divider);
        overflow: visible;
      }



      .metadata {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 4px;
        width: 100%;
        margin-top: 23px;
        color: var(--secondary);
        font-family:
          "Geist Mono",
          "SFMono-Regular",
          Consolas,
          "Liberation Mono",
          Menlo,
          monospace;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 400;
        letter-spacing: 0;
        line-height: 16px;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      }

      .metadata p:first-child {
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .error-page:not(:has(.primary-action)) .metadata {
        margin-top: 8px;
      }

      @media (max-width: 500px) {
        main {
          padding: 24px;
        }

        .error-page {
          max-width: min(var(--content-max-width), calc(100vw - 48px));
        }

        .secondary-actions {
          bottom: calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
          max-width: calc(100vw - 48px);
        }
      }

      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .primary-action,
        .secondary-action {
          transition: none;
        }
      }

    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
      <main>
        <section class="error-page" aria-labelledby="error-title">
          <h1 id="error-title">This request was blocked</h1>
          

          

          <div class="metadata" aria-label="HTTP status, error code, and request ID">
            <p>403 Forbidden</p>
            <p>sfo1::wn7hf-1794311232850-cc700ed84467</p>
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>

      

  </body>
</html>
